title: Barbie Horse Trails
tagline: An open-world ride through Canterbury Trails Park with Lucky.
order_note: In story/roadmap order: most unlock naturally as you finish the main and side quests, so later pops may vary with the order you take side quests.
scope_note: Full game: all 15 achievements / 1,000G. No missables; about 2–4 hours.

achievements.name: Welcome to Canterbury Trails
achievements.how: Finish the prologue at the stable.

achievements.name: Snapshot
achievements.how: Start the Scenic Photography 101 mission with Barbie's father and finish the photography tutorial.

achievements.name: Well Done
achievements.req: Congratulate Lucky on a job well done
achievements.how: After Scenic Photography 101, use the special pet on Lucky ("super pet") at least once after finishing a quest.

achievements.name: New Look
achievements.req: Enter a changing station and change your outfit
achievements.how: Step into a changing station at the Ranger Station or any stable and change any piece of clothing. Outfits come from tasks, boxes lying around, and horse level-ups.

achievements.name: 1st Place
achievements.req: Win first place in a race
achievements.how: Win the story horse race in first place. Other races are marked with a checkered flag on the map, and only one race is mandatory.

achievements.name: Silver Canyon Mustang
achievements.how: Finish Dr. Potts' Mystery Horse questline, through the second artifact, the backpack quest, and the website pictures to the final artifact and the thrilling conclusion.

achievements.name: Ranger Duty II
achievements.req: Complete a mission for Ranger Quinn
achievements.how: Finish your first quest for Ranger Quinn (Trail Trek).

achievements.name: Ranger Duty
achievements.req: Complete a mission for Ranger Rory
achievements.how: Finish your first quest for Ranger Rory.

achievements.name: Green Thumb
achievements.req: Complete a mission for Dr. Green
achievements.how: Finish your first quest for Dr. Green.

achievements.name: Bonded
achievements.req: Reach max level for Horse Bond
achievements.how: Raise Lucky's bond to max level 11: pet her when she asks, brush her, feed her everything you receive, and keep her clean.

achievements.name: Star Search
achievements.how: For Stella, recreate the Big Dipper constellation at her site.

achievements.name: Friends in Need
achievements.req: Complete all the missions for Barbie's friends
achievements.how: Finish every side quest. They are the "!" markers on the map; press Options to track one (blue marker).

achievements.name: Park Progress
achievements.how: Fill the park packet with main and side quests and photos of animals, people, and viewpoints. If the story stalls on the packet bar, clear side quests first, then return to the main quests.

achievements.name: Golden Moments
achievements.req: Get together for the big group photo
achievements.how: Story mission near the end: just follow the quest marker to the big group photo.

achievements.name: Best Friends Forever
achievements.how: Finish the game: go to Barbie on the last quest and let the conversation play out.
